sector: Energy / Solar Manufacturing (GICS: Information Technology — Semiconductors & Semiconductor Equipment)
key_metric: Whether the FY2026 module-shipment guidance of 75-85 GW survives intact. Q1 shipped 13.68 GW and Q2 is guided to 14-16 GW, so H1 lands at 27.7-29.7 GW and the full-year range needs 45.3-57.3 GW in H2 versus 44.2 GW actually shipped in H2 2025 - a swing from -31% YoY to flat-or-better while China's H1 2026 installations fell 66% and module output fell 35.1%. Roth's Philip Shen put this arithmetic to management on the Q1 call and got no answer. Secondary: Q2 gross margin vs Q1's 8.3%, and the accounting for the $191.5m May-2026 sale of 75.1% of the Jacksonville US plant, which consensus almost certainly does not model. The -$0.75 EPS consensus is NOT the bar - it is a restatement of guidance and implies only ~8% gross margin.
